geometry_edits.rationale: Introduce a split-wing mass to create a coherent main/support relationship and a legible public void at the access edge.
Split along the primary span so the opening reads in plan and section.
Create a substantial but controlled void between wings.
Preserve a grounded connector so the building remains one massing idea.
Keep the base spine wide enough to anchor the composition.
Lift the public threshold enough to be read as an active ground condition.

graph_edits.rationale: Replace the single cantilever gesture with a split-wing organization so the mass can form a clearer public threshold and improve hierarchy for neighborhood living.
Split along the long axis to open a legible void toward the access edge rather than remaining a sealed block.
Introduce a meaningful gap to create publicness at ground level without fragmenting the object.
Keep a grounded connector so the composition remains one dominant mass rather than two unrelated pieces.
Maintain a substantial base spine to support program and keep the public cut as a contained gesture.
Raise the active ground portion enough to read as occupied public threshold rather than decorative subtraction.

rationale: The candidate reads as a compact stepped/cantilevered object inside the parcel, but the dominant gesture is not yet strongly legible across all views and the void logic is weak. The mass is coherent enough not to fail on fragmentation, and the overall repair looks intact, but it behaves more like a generic stacked block than a neighborhood-living building with an active public threshold. The verified access edge is not convincingly answered by a carved court, undercut, or entry seam; the blue frontage remains largely sealed semantically. Program fit fails because the visible section does not yet express a strong ground/public relationship for mixed neighborhood living, even though the silhouette is not intrinsically wrong. References suggest a clearer hierarchy and a more deliberate public base/upper mass split, but the candidate currently lacks that section clarity.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Much taller and more tower-like than this low compact neighborhood-living candidate; the candidate should not copy the tower typology.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Stepped/tapered upper mass with a clear dominant object and legible profile variation.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Office tower language is only partially transferable; this program needs active ground threshold and usable public void, which the reference does not supply.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: The candidate is much more compact and volumetric; do not over-literalize the canopy/sign element.
